title: Fermionic non-Gaussianity via Bell sampling: monotones and efficient quantum algorithms
summary: Fermionic non-Gaussianity is an essential resource for unlocking the full computational power of fermionic quantum platforms. In this work we develop monotones and efficient quantum algorithms for fermionic non-Gaussianity, all built on the eigenvalue structure of the operator $Λ= \sum_{j=1}^{2n}γ_j\otimesγ_j$ defined on two copies of an $n$-mode fermionic state, accessible via Bell sampling.
